description: Java class 'SmsDataValidator' responsible for validating SMS data payloads for create and update operations within the Fineract platform, including JSON parsing, parameter validation, and error handling.

classes.name: SmsDataValidator
classes.description: Final class providing validation methods for SMS data payloads, ensuring required parameters are present and valid, and handling JSON parsing and error reporting.

methods.name: validateForCreate
methods.description: Validates JSON input for creating an SMS, checking for required parameters, unsupported parameters, and value constraints.

methods.name: validateForUpdate
methods.description: Validates JSON input for updating an SMS, primarily checking for the message parameter.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Throws a validation exception if any validation errors have been collected.
